title: Create stocktake session — scope, operators, snapshot
objective: Verify POST /stocktakes creates a session with name, location scope, operators, start/due dates, and a snapshot of expected assets.
preconditions: manager session (create permission); operator user for counting; seeded locations with assets.
test_data: {name: 'QA Cycle2 Count', locations: [<loc uuid>], operators: [<operator uuid>], start: today, due: +7d}
steps: POST /api/v1/stocktakes; verify 201 with uuid, status draft/created, snapshot_at set.
Verify session scoped asset set is fixed at snapshot (create a new asset in scope AFTER snapshot; it must not appear as expected).
Verify audit event for session creation.
expected_result: Session persisted with immutable snapshot of expected assets at snapshot_at; later registrations excluded from expected set; audited.

title: Stocktake session authorization
objective: Verify only Manager+ can create sessions; operators can count only in assigned sessions; employee/auditor denied.
preconditions: sessions for operator, employee, auditor; existing session assigned to a different operator.
steps: POST observation by assigned operator → success.
expected_result: Role rules enforced with envelope errors; only assigned operators record observations.

title: Record observations — found, idempotent scan submission
objective: Verify POST /stocktakes/:uuid/observations records time, operator, location, condition, note; repeated submission with same Idempotency-Key does not duplicate.
preconditions: started session; assigned operator; expected asset E in scope.
test_data: {tag_scanned: '<E tag>', condition: good, location: <uuid>, note: 'on shelf'} + Idempotency-Key qa-obs-0001
steps: POST observation; verify 201, outcome=found, observed_at set server-side.
Repeat identical request with same key; verify single observation only.
Verify lifecycle/audit linkage (observation recorded against session + asset).
expected_result: Observation persisted with correct classification; idempotent replay safe; events attributable to operator with correlation ID.

title: Observation outcome classification — unexpected, duplicate, moved, condition-mismatch
objective: Verify outcome classification rules: tag not in snapshot → unexpected; same tag scanned twice → duplicate; found at different location than snapshot → moved; observed condition differs → condition_mismatch; unobserved expected assets → not_found at reconciliation.
preconditions: session with expected assets at location L1; asset X not in snapshot; asset E expected at L1 with condition 'good'.
test_data: observations: X's tag; E's tag twice; E at location L2; E with condition 'damaged'
steps: Submit each observation variant (fresh sessions or per-case fixtures to avoid duplicate suppression).
Verify outcome values on each observation.
At reconciliation, verify unobserved expected assets are classified not_found.
expected_result: Each observation classified per rules; not_found derivable at reconciliation; classifications visible in variance data.

title: Session lifecycle — start, and close requires permission + variance report
objective: Verify session start transitions status and locks scope; close requires authorized role and produces a final variance report; reconciliation review precedes any master-data updates.
preconditions: draft session; started session with observations; manager and operator sessions.
steps: POST /stocktakes/:uuid/start → status in_progress; verify observations rejected before start in a second draft session (or per contract).
GET /stocktakes/:uuid/variance → verify found/not_found/unexpected/moved counts reconcile with observations.
POST close as operator → 403; POST close as manager → 200 with final variance summary.
Verify closed session rejects further observations (409).
expected_result: Lifecycle transitions enforced; variance report accurate and required at close; close permission-gated; session immutable after close; full audit trail.

title: Mobile count UI — scan/manual observation entry with connectivity-loss honesty
objective: Verify /stocktakes/[id]/count works on a mobile viewport: scan or manual entry, immediate confirmation on server success, and honest error + retry on connectivity loss (no false 'saved').
preconditions: browser + running stack (BLOCKED if unavailable); started session.
steps: On mobile viewport, submit an observation; verify success confirmation only after server response.
Simulate network failure; submit again; verify explicit failure message + retry, no false saved state.
expected_result: Confirmed-only-on-server-success UX; offline attempts show failure + retry (design D-03/layout §15.3); no data claims without confirmation.
